network.description: Network ID. Call listSupportedNetworks for all options. e.g. "solana-mainnet"

tools.name: solanaGetAssetsByAuthority
tools.description: Get all Solana assets managed by a specific authority address

network.description: Network ID. Call listSupportedNetworks for all options. e.g. "solana-mainnet"
